function: above_phy: the DNN actor only learns binary computation offloading (MTD-to-AAV/HAP edge server) decisions; transmit power, time-slot and CPU allocation are solved by convex optimization (p. 6).
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Excluded as above_phy: the learning makes task offloading / edge computing decisions, which the instructions list above the PHY. p. 6: "the resource allocation problem to optimize ζ(t) is in fact an “easy” convex problem if offloading decision x(t) is fixed"; the Actor output is "multiple discrete candidate offloading decisions x(t) determined by the DNNs and the action quantization mechanism", and the Critic obtains the resource allocation y*(t) from the optimization algorithm. p. 8-9: MTD transmit power by a closed-form stationary point (P4 "is classified as convex"), time slots by linear programming (P5-P6), CPU frequencies by KKT/Lagrangian dual (P7-P9). Although the links are aerial (AAV/HAP), the transmit power and resource allocation are not learned, so neither the aerial-link exception nor the joint PHY/above-PHY exception of check 4 applies. Results are queue backlog and energy consumption (p. 10-12).
